notes.title: Update #2 available now
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

A new update is available now for Tony Tough which contains the following improvements on Windows, MacOS and Linux:

Updated ScummVM to ScummVM 2.0.0 which also contains an update to Simple DirectMedia Layer 2 (SDL2). This should improve compatibility with a lot of monitor setups and resolve mouse issues,
Upgraded Linux Executable to Ubuntu 16.04 LTS 64-bit

You can learn more about ScummVM at  ScummVM.org

Enjoy the update!
Daniel,
Night Dive Studios

notes.title: Update #1 available now
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

There is an update available now for Tony Tough and the Night of Roasted Moths which includes the following updates and changes:

Updated the ScummVM engine from 1.7.0 to 1.9.0.2,
Translation files updated,
Steam Cloud Save support has been enabled. Saves will be synced, and can be played across, Windows, Mac, and Linux,
Updated internal depot configuration.

Enjoy!
Daniel,
Nightdive Studios.
